from collections import deque

ones=[(i,j) for i in range(20) for j in range(20) if do[i][j]==1]
comps=[]

    if p in seen: continue
    q=deque([p]); comp=[]; seen.add(p)

        c=q.popleft(); comp.append(c)
        for a,b in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
